Title: The Day the Earth Blew Up: A Looney Tunes Movie
FullTitle: The Day the Earth Blew Up: A Looney Tunes Movie
SortTitle: Day the Earth Blew Up: A Looney Tunes Movie, The
Plot: Porky and Daffy, the classic animated odd couple, turn into unlikely heroes when their antics at the local bubble gum factory uncover a secret alien mind control plot. Against all odds, the two are determined to save their town (and the world!)...that is if they don't drive each other crazy in the process.
Tagline: To save the world, they'll have to stick together.
